eyebrow: Data Modeling & Data Warehousing · Chapter 6, Lesson 30
subtitle: Pre-summarized tables built on top of a detailed fact table

code:
CREATE TABLE agg_sale_by_date_region AS
SELECT OrderDateKey, Region,
       SUM(Revenue) AS TotalRevenue
FROM FactSale AS FS
JOIN DimRegion AS DR
  ON FS.RegionKey = DR.RegionKey
GROUP BY OrderDateKey, Region;
caption: CTAS groups the detailed fact into a small, pre-summarized table.
